title: Builder Extended Rate Lock Extension Length Pricing
content:
Longer extensions of a Builder Extended Rate Lock carry a higher extension fee percent.

**Rule.** The increments priced are the extension days used on the lock less the extension days already carried by extension fee charges on the lock ledger, divided by the term's increment days. An extension of three or more increments adds 0.0625 percentage points to the extension fee percent; an extension of two increments adds 0.03125 percentage points; a single increment adds nothing. The points are added to the extension fee percent before it is applied to the loan amount on the lock.

| Increments priced | Added to the extension fee percent |
|---|---|
| 1 | nothing |
| 2 | 0.03125 percentage points |
| 3 or more | 0.0625 percentage points |

## Counting the increments priced (hypothetical figures, 7-day increments)

- Extension days used 21, none charged on the ledger: 21 divided by 7 is 3 increments priced; 0.0625 points are added.
- Extension days used 21, 7 already carried by an extension fee charge: 14 days, 2 increments priced; 0.03125 points are added.
- Extension days used 21, 14 already carried: 7 days, 1 increment priced; nothing is added.

Hypothetical effect: an extension fee percent of 0.125 on a two-increment extension becomes 0.15625.
